name: Retail settings (feature toggles + earn basis + Save)
notes: Interaction targets: f-<key>.check (tick a feature; dirty = Category missions ticked), basis-select / basis-menu / basis-opt-n, save (disabled until a change: is-disabled -> primary in dirty). Flags f{n}_chk / saveCls / basisCls / menuCls are class slots set by scripts/la-page-retail-settings.mjs from data/<region>/retail_settings.json.
